name: overview-hotkeys-open-the-rail-pane
description: The user's report on 2026-09-13 was 'cmd+shift+a does something really weird. it opens the overview, but in a web card'. Cmd+Shift+A is openArchive, not the Overview toggle, but both ran the same code and both showed Overview in a widget sized to the web-content pane. Both are driven here in one run: Cmd+Shift+A is the reported key, and Cmd+Shift+O is the one a fix aimed only at the archive path would quietly leave broken.

actions.note: let the window finish first paint and the sidebar announce itself
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
the first workspace at rest, before either hotkey
openArchive - the key the user actually pressed
the rail glides to the Overview pane and the section asks for its data
toggleOverview pages the rail back to the active space
and forward again, so the toggle is proven in both directions

assertions.desc: Neither hotkey may open a second window. This read 2 for both of them before the fix.
assertions.label: no-hotkey-opens-a-second-window
cmd-shift-a-leaves-the-page-visible
assertions.desc: THE assertion for the user's report. The page under this region is white, so the widget that used to cover it pulls the mean down - it measured 222.5 there. Paired with the sidebar check below, which fails if Overview simply never opened and left the page white by default.

assertions.label: cmd-shift-a-really-opened-overview-in-the-sidebar
assertions.desc: The foot of the widened sidebar: 122.7 with the Overview pane parked there against 185.6 at rest, so the band excludes rest. The floor of 5 stops a black frame from passing.

assertions.label: cmd-shift-a-selected-the-archived-section
assertions.desc: Opening Overview is not what Cmd+Shift+A asks for - it asks for the Archived section. Without this the scenario passes on a run that landed on Downloads, the default section, which looks equally correct from the outside. The section NAME is the assertion: every pane render pushes all six lists, so a push line would match whatever section is showing.

assertions.label: cmd-shift-o-still-reaches-overview-after-a-round-trip
assertions.desc: Two presses of Cmd+Shift+O: away from Overview, then back. A fix that pointed only openArchive at the rail pane would leave the toggle on the retired widget, and this is where that shows.
Cmd+Q still quits cleanly with the Overview pane on screen
